categories.main_business_segments: The company's primary business is architectural design research, consulting, and technical services. The main business segments include residential building design and consulting, public building design and consulting, and functional mixed-use community design and consulting. All main business revenue comes from architectural design and consulting services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs design methodologies including concept design, scheme design, preliminary design, construction drawing design, and construction coordination. Core technologies include BIM (Building Information Modeling), AI-assisted architectural design, digital twin visualization, green building design, prefabricated building design, and full-process engineering consulting. The company has established a quality control system based on 'four meetings for finalization and two reviews with one evaluation' to ensure design quality throughout the process.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include major real estate developers such as Greenland Holdings, China Poly Group, China Jinmao, Vanke Group, China Resources Land, China State Construction, China Merchants, and China Ocean Shipping. The company serves both residential and commercial real estate development sectors, as well as government and institutional clients for urban renewal and infrastructure projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Shanghai and regional offices in major cities including Shenzhen, Wuhan, Nanjing, Changsha, and other key economic development zones. The company's revenue is geographically distributed across East China (65.14%), Southwest China (9.49%), North China (9.20%), South China (8.87%), Central China (4.01%), Northwest China (1.93%), and Northeast China (1.36%).
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the upstream and midstream segments of the construction value chain, providing design and consulting services before construction begins. The company is positioned as a service provider to real estate developers and construction companies, offering front-end design services including concept design, scheme design, and preliminary design, as well as full-process engineering consulting services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on four strategic directions: integration (extending services across design disciplines), specialization (developing non-real estate design capabilities), internationalization (enhancing technical levels through international cooperation), and digitalization (exploring AI-assisted design and digital tools). R&D priorities include advanced technologies such as AI-assisted architectural design, BIM technology, green building design, prefabricated construction, and full-process engineering consulting platforms.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through project-based architectural design and consulting services. Revenue is recognized when design deliverables are completed and accepted by clients, typically at various project stages including concept design, scheme design, preliminary design, and construction drawing design. The company also generates minor revenue from property rental and sales of real estate assets acquired through debt restructuring.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with state-owned large design enterprises (such as China Architecture Design and Research Group), international design firms (such as SOM and AECOM), and other domestic private design firms. The company positions itself as a leading domestic architectural design enterprise with particular strength in high-end, complex public building design, urban renewal, and mixed-use community design. The company ranks among the first tier of domestic architectural design enterprises by business scale.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported 2024 revenue of 2.14 billion yuan, down 43.61% from 3.79 billion yuan in 2023, reflecting industry-wide challenges in the real estate sector. The company recorded a net loss of 220.29 million yuan in 2024 compared to net profit of 7.87 million yuan in 2023. Total assets were 2.995 billion yuan at year-end 2024, with strong liquidity including 1.351 billion yuan in cash and cash equivalents. The company maintains a low debt-to-asset ratio of 4.76%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through exceptional creative and innovative capabilities, particularly in high-end and complex architectural design domains including super-high-rise buildings, large commercial complexes, urban renewal, and mixed-use communities. The company emphasizes design quality through rigorous process control, integration of advanced technologies like BIM and AI, and a team of experienced architects with international vision. The company has established strong brand recognition through award-winning projects and long-term partnerships with leading real estate developers.
